question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Coordinated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Coordinated **means to organize or arrange something in a particular way. (समन्वित)

 
 
• **Example**: *The team coordinated their efforts to complete the project on time.*
 
 
 
• The word "**coordinated**" is suitable in the given sentence because it suggests that the efforts of government departments are well-organized, harmonized, and working together in a systematic manner.
 
• So, it is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sustained **means to maintain or continue for a prolonged period of time. (स्थिर किया हुआ)
 
• **Compromised **means** **to accept less than you want or are aiming for, especially in order to reach an agreement

 (अभीष्‍ट से कुछ कम पर मान जाना, विशेषतः सुलह या समझौते के लिए)
 
• **Gathered **means to collect or assemble something. (इकट्ठा)
